companion_rules: Default preview, download, and print targets must resolve from the current artifact only.
Historical artifact targets remain selectable state, not ambient global defaults.
A customer-safe derivative published from an internal-only source must mint a new target and a new delivery binding.
Copy-on-publish may mint new storage and target families while preserving upstream durable artifact refs for lineage.

companion_rules: PREVIEW: Previews remain route-bound and object-bound so stale tabs cannot widen access.
DOWNLOAD: Download handles are disposable and may not masquerade as durable refs.
PRINT: Print remains a sibling affordance to preview and download, not a fallback from either.
EXTERNALIZATION: Externalized delivery remains a governed derivative surface and may require additional visibility partitioning.
